purpose: Exhaust the complete distinct nonwinding observation set on the primitive 12-edge D4 fixture and quantify exact logical-sector inference across a small prior matrix.
epistemic_role: Bounded exact intrinsic-information audit; not a finite-size performance estimate, threshold, or scalable decoder result.
prior_rationale: p=0.1 and p=0.6 preserve the exact R3/R4 semantic fixtures; p=0.3 probes the sparse-error interior; p=0.5 removes Bernoulli weight preference and isolates the conditioned observation likelihood.

observation_enumeration.nonwinding_rule: For every nonwinding physical error mask, enumerate every charge assignment on exactly the degree-two internal vertices that satisfies all geometry-derived parity constraints. The observation key is the complete flux vector plus the complete {-1,0,1} charge vector.
observation_enumeration.conditional_likelihood: Every allowed record has P(s|E)=2^(C-N_internal); the allowed probabilities for each fixed nonwinding E must sum to one.
observation_enumeration.deduplication: Deduplicate identical observation keys before posterior analysis while retaining the complete compatible error-mask set.
observation_enumeration.terminal_winding_rule: Physical masks with a nontrivial winding component remain terminal ground-state-relative logical failures. They receive no fabricated charge record and are excluded from conditioned nonwinding posteriors.

analysis.sector_reference: Lexicographically first compatible error mask for each observation; reference relabeling may change sector names but not evidence multisets or risks.
analysis.configuration_map_comparison: Compare the set of sectors occupied by all maximum-weight configurations with the set of maximum-evidence logical sectors. Report exact singleton agreement, set overlap, and forced disjoint disagreement; also report the lexicographic configuration-MAP convention separately.
analysis.weighting: Report both unweighted structural counts over distinct observations and observation-probability-weighted distributions at each p. Weighted nonwinding summaries are normalized by nonterminal mass.

required: all 4096 physical masks are classified exactly once
the terminal winding-mask count reproduces the R3.5 value 123
allowed observation likelihoods normalize to one for every nonwinding physical mask
terminal prior mass plus summed nonwinding observation evidence equals one at every registered p
every sector posterior normalizes and has Bayes risk in [0,1]
R4.0 exact fractions and both R4.1 invariance/summation fixtures are reproduced
an independently selected observation subset agrees with exact_conditioned_logical_posterior
no winding-sector charge likelihood or absolute-sector label is invented

compute_budget.stop_rule: Stop after one exact primitive enumeration, registered prior matrix, validation suite, machine-readable audit, and report update; do not increase lattice size or launch LER sampling.
